import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('/root/hotel.csv')
print(df.head())                       # 读 + 打印（截图点）

df = df.dropna(subset=['商圈'])         # 1 删商圈为空的行
df = df.dropna(axis=1, thresh=len(df)-3)  # 2 删缺失值 > 3 的列
df['评分'] = df['评分'].fillna(0)        # 3 评分空置 0
mean_score = round(df['评分'].mean(), 1) # 4 总平均，保留一位小数
df['评分'] = df['评分'].replace(0, mean_score)

print('处理条数:', len(df))
